<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* test-bot: skip bottles for unsatisfiable formulae by @daeho-ro in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24104
* Time out stalled cask audit downloads by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24108
* cask: remove pre-staged downloads when installs fail by @dergachoff in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24107
* diagnostic: allowlist JPKI client dylibs by @ttsuru in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24110
* shell: fish-quote the fish profile line by @rawsun007 in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24114
* keg: keep versioned opt aliases that still point at an installed keg by @erikdw in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24113
* docs/_layouts/base.html: fix heading permalinks by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24116
* Support bumping cask versions per platform by @waldyrious in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24111
* Prevent SSH prompts during sandboxed Git fetches by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24117
* Fix flaky cleanup and bottle tests by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24118
* sandbox: allow Keychain trust evaluation on macOS by @gritse in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24120
* Allow symlinked Git config in download sandbox by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24121
* dev-cmd/bump-formula-pr: append `patch` checkbox to `formula_checkboxes` by @botantony in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24122
* sandbox: allow system trust evaluation online by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24126
* bump: use refresh_for_tag for per-OS detection by @krehel in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24127
* Load legacy formula DSL in history walks by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24131
* cask/utils: don't follow symlinks when gaining permissions by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24134
* Allow Git downloads to use the GitHub API token by @gritse in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24128
* Use a private working directory in the sandbox by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24132
* generate-cask-ci-matrix: add Golden Gate runner by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24135
* Improve install, upgrade and reinstall output by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24138
* Check sudo access only when first needed by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24139
* formatter: round before picking the unit in disk_usage_readable by @rawsun007 in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24144
* Recognize legacy PyPI resource URLs by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24142
* Deduplicate combined upgrade summaries by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24149
* Isolate deferred messages between test examples by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24148
* Handle unresolved Cask effective groups by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24146
* contributions: count coauthors for amended commits by @iMichka in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24125
* Docs: install script no longer supports macOS Intel by @NReilingh in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24151
* pr-publish: add `--warn-on-upload-failure` by @daeho-ro in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24081
* Re-enable sort cop for zsh and fish completions by @AlternateRT in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24050
* formulary: link tap issues when formulae print by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24156
* utils/shell: general cleanup. by @rawsun007 in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24154
* Protect Homebrew locks from sandboxed hooks by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24157
* Use runtime platform for vendored gem extensions by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24159
* advisory-match: include mixed build versions by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24161
* Support monthly maintainer reports by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24162

## New Contributors
* @dergachoff made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24107
* @ttsuru made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24110
* @erikdw made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24113
* @gritse made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24120
* @NReilingh made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24151

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/compare/7.0.7...7.0.8
